brief: This filament rack is already built: four spool bays, each with a spool axle across it, and open bins on the pillar tops. Do not change the parts. Dress it for use: a 1 kg filament spool hanging on every axle, and a few small printing tools in the open top bins.

requirements.requirement: A few small printing tools in the open top bins (pillar tops)

finish.summary: Dressed existing filament rack without changing parts: hung filament spool on all 4 axles via hang_spools, and placed small printing-related consumables (M3 screws/nuts div3) into the divided top bins via fill_compartments. Build checks clear with no prop warnings.

M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
